messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: SimpleQuestion_ask
function.description: Presents a simple question based on the provided context and expects an answer from a predefined set of options. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

question.description: The question posed to the user.

answer.description: The selected answer to the question, which must be one of the provided options.

context.description: The context or scenario in which the question is being asked, providing additional information to the user.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long weekends** that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a holiday that falls on a Friday or Monday, or is observed on a Monday when it lands on a weekend, giving you a three‑day break.)

| Date(s) | Holiday | Notes |
|---------|---------|-------|
| **Jan 1 – 3** | New Year’s Day (observed Mon Jan 2) | New Year’s Day fell on Sunday, so the holiday was observed on Monday. |
| **Feb 18 – 20** | Family Day (Ontario) | Family Day in Ontario is the third Monday in February. |
| **Apr 7 – 9** | Good Friday | Good Friday is a statutory holiday in all provinces. |
| **May 20 – 22** | Victoria Day | Victoria Day is the Monday preceding May 25. |
| **Jul 1 – 3** | Canada Day (observed Mon Jul 3) | Canada Day fell on Saturday, so the holiday was observed on Monday. |
| **Sep 2 – 4** | Labour Day | Labour Day is the first Monday in September. |
| **Oct 7 – 9** | Thanksgiving | Thanksgiving is the second Monday in October. |
| **Nov 11 – 13** | Remembrance Day (observed Mon Nov 13) | Remembrance Day fell on Saturday, so the holiday was observed on Monday. |
| **Dec 23 – 25** | Christmas Day | Christmas Day fell on Monday. |

> **Tip for your app** – If you want to support provincial variations (e.g., Family Day in Alberta, St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, etc.), you’ll need to add those dates separately. The table above covers the federal holidays that create long weekends across the country in 2023.

There's no tool to fetch data. We can answer directly. Provide list of long weekends in Canada 2023. We need to consider federal holidays that create long weekends. In Canada, federal holidays: New Year's Day (Jan 1), Family Day (varies by province), Good Friday (varies), Victoria Day (May 22), Canada Day (July 1), Labour Day (Sep 4), Thanksgiving (Oct 9), Remembrance Day (Nov 11), Christmas Day (Dec 25), Boxing Day (Dec 26). Long weekends occur when a holiday falls on a Friday or Monday, or if a holiday is observed on a Monday if it falls on weekend. Also some provinces have extra holidays. But the user likely wants national long weekends. Let's list those that create long weekends in 2023:

- New Year's Day: Jan 1 2023 is Sunday. Observed on Monday Jan 2. So long weekend Jan 1-3? Actually Jan 1-3 is weekend plus Monday. So long weekend Jan 1-3.

- Family Day: In Ontario, Family Day is third Monday in February. In 2023, Family Day in Ontario is Feb 20. That's a Monday, so long weekend Feb 18-20? Actually weekend Feb 18-19 plus Monday Feb 20. So long weekend Feb 18-20.

- Good Friday: Good Friday 2023 is April 7. So long weekend Apr 7-9 (Friday to Sunday). Also Easter Monday is not a holiday in Canada.

- Victoria Day: May 22 2023 is Monday. So long weekend May 20-22.

- Canada Day: July 1 2023 is Saturday. Observed on Monday July 3. So long weekend July 1-3.

- Labour Day: Sep 4 2023 is Monday. So long weekend Sep 2-4.

- Thanksgiving: Oct 9 2023 is Monday. So long weekend Oct 7-9.

- Remembrance Day: Nov 11 2023 is Saturday. Observed on Monday Nov 13. So long weekend Nov 11-13.

- Christmas Day: Dec 25 2023 is Monday. So long weekend Dec 23-25.

- Boxing Day: Dec 26 2023 is Tuesday. Not a long weekend unless combined with Christmas? Actually Christmas Monday, Boxing Tuesday, so no long weekend.

Also New Year's Day 2024 will be Monday Jan 1 2024? Actually 2024 Jan 1 is Monday. But 2023 only.
